name: myzipmaster
description: MyZipMaster - cross-platform archive manager (Web / Windows / macOS / Linux): ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR and more, with split volumes of any size. Tauri + React + a Rust engine that also compiles to WebAssembly.
author: SHKWON <knix008@naver.com>

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:wasm && node scripts/dev.mjs web
scripts.build:ui: npm run generate:build-info && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.build:web: npm run generate:build-info && npm run build:wasm && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --mode web
scripts.build:debug: npm run build:ui && node scripts/build-sfx.mjs debug && cargo build -p myzipmaster
scripts.build:win: node node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/tauri.js build --bundles nsis && node scripts/copy-installer.mjs
scripts.build:mac: node node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/tauri.js build --bundles dmg && node scripts/copy-installer.mjs
scripts.build:linux: node node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/tauri.js build --bundles appimage,deb && node scripts/copy-installer.mjs
